story.title: New White House Press Secretary Admits She Did Not Pass Bar Exam
story.summary: Katie Zacharia, the new White House press secretary, has acknowledged that she did not pass the bar exam, raising questions about her legal qualifications. Reports indicate that she is not registered to practice law in any state where she has lived, leading to scrutiny of her legal career prior to her appointment.

timeline_highlights.title: Scrutiny Grows Over Credentials of Trump's New Press Secretary Katie Zacharia
timeline_highlights.summary: Katie Zacharia, the newly appointed White House press secretary, is facing increasing scrutiny regarding her legal credentials. Questions have arisen about her claims of being a lawyer, as reports indicate she may not be registered with the bar in any state where she has lived. Additionally, her first day in the role was marked by an unclear response about where she passed the bar exam.
key_facts: Katie Zacharia is the new White House press secretary.
There are questions about her legal credentials and claims of being a lawyer.
She may not be registered with the bar in any state.

related_stories.title: Houthi Missile Attack on Yemeni Presidential Palace Leaves Casualties
related_stories.summary: A Houthi missile attack targeted the presidential palace in Aden, Yemen, resulting in five fatalities and 16 injuries, according to officials. The palace serves as the seat of the internationally recognized government. Conflicting reports indicate that at least two people were killed in related explosions near the palace.

related_stories.title: Ukraine Resumes Strikes on Russian Energy Targets Amid Ongoing Attacks
related_stories.summary: Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian energy targets, stating that Russia never ceased its attacks. This decision follows a period of pause, which Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has now ended in response to fresh Russian offensives. The situation escalates amid tensions between Ukraine and external parties regarding calls for a ceasefire.

related_stories.title: Ukraine Introduces Drone Ambulance for Battlefield Rescue
related_stories.summary: A Ukrainian company has showcased a new drone ambulance designed for battlefield rescue. The drone, named StarGate and developed by SkyFall, can transport a wounded soldier in an enclosed cabin. Demonstrations included the drone taking off, flying, and landing with a person on board.

related_stories.title: Zelensky Criticizes Trump's Diesel Deal with Russia at EU Summit
related_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized U.S. President Donald Trump's recent diesel deal with Russia during a European Union summit in Brussels. He expressed concern that easing sanctions could financially benefit Moscow and welcomed the idea of European allies increasing their involvement in negotiations. Zelensky described Russia's approach to peace talks as a 'parody' and emphasized Ukraine's ongoing challenges, including disruptions to its satellite systems.
